postings.title: Thankly | Founding Engineer, Founding Engineer (RL Environments), Founding Product Designer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time |
postings.body: Thankly | Founding Engineer, Founding Engineer (RL Environments), Founding Product Designer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | Equity-first Thankly builds branded shopping apps that run inside AI assistants, including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Shoppers ask for what they need in conversation, the app recommends products from the brand's own catalog, and they can check out without leaving the chat. Founding Engineer: Build our platform and client apps on React, Vite, Express, TypeScript, Supabase and Postgres, working from technical designs written by our CTO. You have 3+ years of full-time experience and build with AI coding tools like Claude Code or Codex every day.  https://thankly.ai/careers/founding-engineer  Founding Engineer, RL Environments: Build RL environments for shopping agents from real shopper questions, including tasks, scoring rubrics and automated graders. Experience with LLM evaluation, reward design or AI training data is a plus.  https://thankly.ai/careers/rl-environments  Founding Product Designer: Own the UX of the apps we build for clients and of our own platform, and set the patterns for how shopping works inside AI conversations. 3+ years of full-time product design experience and a portfolio.  https://thankly.ai/careers/product-designer  These are equity-first founding roles. At least 4 hours a day of overlap with Eastern Time. To apply, email harsh@thankly.ai with your GitHub or portfolio and one sentence about the best thing you've built.

postings.body: BuildQ | Founding Engineer | REMOTE (PT to ET overlap preferred) | $130K - $150K + equity | Full-time | Seed |  https://buildq.ai/careers/founding-engineer  Hey folks! I'm Dylan, CTO at BuildQ, and we're building out our founding eng team. Today, a $200M solar project sits for weeks while someone reads thousands of PDFs before it can be financed. We make that review fast: customers order diligence from us, our agents do the work, and an expert signs off. We've processed 200,000+ documents across 1,100+ projects so far. We're remote, and the benefits are great (a startup with a 401k match!). We're looking for a Founding Engineer to join 2 of us on the engineering team. You'll ship to production on your first day, and you'll help shape what the future of BuildQ looks like. Stack: Rails, Python, React, TS, Postgres, AWS Email careers@buildq.ai with "HN Founding Engineer", anything you're proud to share that you've built, and any questions you may have.
